pkgmetadata.longdescription: md2hd reads a markdown file or a folder of notes and draws them as a graph: frontmatter blocks become nodes and wikilinks become edges. The CLI serves a prebuilt visualizer on the loopback interface and opens it in a browser, re-reading the files on every request, so saving a note and refreshing the tab redraws the map. Nothing is sent off the machine. The bundled app is shipped prebuilt because upstream builds it in a separate, unpublished repository.
